translation_direction: fr → vi; direct from the specifically identified complete French electronic witness
ai_disclosure: Direct AI-produced Vietnamese prose by Claude Opus 5.5. The drafting system conducted the final full assessment; a separate-context assessment by the same model family read every pair and supplied findings first. No human translator, editor, reviewer, independent model consensus or actual reader feedback is recorded.

entry_conditions: Complete named-source and Vietnamese texts, explicit alignment and exact content hashes.
Compare every source and target passage; disclose that this assessor also revised the text and has seen earlier AI assessments.
Source and target edition titles are present and compared explicitly; the title review must match both catalog title strings exactly.
exit_conditions: One complete AI review with a weighted score at least 8.6 using the five unchanged weights and half-point category scores; no separate numerical dimension floors.
All canonical passages reviewed; no unresolved major or critical finding; source and target hashes match the final text.
Publication and rights status are recorded separately in the edition catalog; an AI score does not supply a license.
The selected review includes source_title, target_title and a substantive title rationale; changed titles require a fresh matching review.
review_process.human_feedback: Optional after publication or while a work remains a draft; no prior human publication review is required by v2.

decisions.decision: Félicité is chị throughout; she calls herself con with Mme Aubain and tôi with others; Mme Aubain addresses her as chị.
decisions.rationale: Stable relational register across the fifty years of the story.

decisions.decision: Flaubert’s deadpan irony, ternary lists and em-dash pivots are kept without added comment, piety or sentiment.
decisions.rationale: The tale’s balance between tenderness and irony is its voice.

decisions.decision: Paragraph-initial dialogue uses a dash without quotation marks throughout; inline speech uses curly quotes.
decisions.rationale: Vietnamese convention; the witness itself varies between parts.

revision_history.scope: Complete initial direct translation, separate-context full source/target assessment and concrete revisions before the selected final review.

changes.explanation: «Est-il bien?» no longer narrowed to the parrot’s looks: Nó có ổn không?
«Ça ne leur fait rien, à eux!» now means ‘it means nothing to them’, without added contempt.
Papillons from the wardrobe are moths (con nhậy), matching the vermin-eaten hat.
«insignifiantes actions» as việc vụn vặt (trivial), not vô nghĩa.
Clarified that it is Madame who panics over Virginie.
Ungrammatical sentence about Bourais’s face rewritten; calques in 2.19, 3.84, 3.68 and 3.29 smoothed.
Recurring motifs fixed: cuốn địa lý có tranh khắc and the nhung lông dài hat; la mère Simon consistently bà Simon; reposoir bàn thờ tạm.
Paragraph-initial dialogue punctuation standardised across both halves.

selection_limit: Chosen for a complete, directly sourced and openly reusable Vietnamese edition. Existing Vietnamese translations, their quality and reader demand have not been comprehensively assessed; no absence or superiority claim is made.

glossary.draft_rendering: bà chủ, bà Aubain / Bà, Ông (in quotation)
glossary.rationale: Félicité’s world is defined by her mistress; capitalised Bà/Ông keep the household’s reverent «Monsieur».
Standard Vietnamese Catholic term, fixed in all occurrences because the parrot–Spirit fusion depends on it.
Catholic liturgical vocabulary; mặt nhật keeps the sun image of «son grand soleil d’or».
Flaubert’s two forms of address are kept distinct.

witness_decision: Selected the complete UN COEUR SIMPLE section (parts I–V) of Trois contes, cinquième édition (Paris: G. Charpentier, 1877), as transcribed in Project Gutenberg #12065. First published in Le Moniteur universel, April 1877; not collated.

unresolved_questions.explanation: Period measures (dặm, khắc) kept without notes.
Part IV occasionally says cô Virginie where earlier parts use the bare name.

title_review.rationale: Một tấm lòng chất phác keeps cœur as the seat of love (tấm lòng) and simple as guileless, not plain; the assessor preferred it to Một tâm hồn chất phác, which clashed with âmes in the text.

passage_assessment_notes.assessment: Fifty years of service sketched in Flaubert’s ironic inventory.
The final vision keeps «crut voir» open between delusion and grace.
